runs.text: Read 5 numbers and show them in reverse order, one per line.

hints.text: Can you start showing before you have read the last number?
Keep the five in an array, like the temperatures in
To show them backwards, the index has to go from the last to the first.
One loop that reads from 0 to 4 and another that shows from 4 to 0

runs.text: Show only the ones in even positions: 0, 2 and 4.
Hidden cases: repeated numbers that make a program that does not reverse look right (7, 7, 7) and negatives. Frequent mistake: starting the second loop at 5.
